docs.title: Welcome to Saurabh Shukla’s Tech Docs 🚀
docs.text: 👋 Hi, I’m Saurabh Shukla — a seasoned Database & Middleware Administrator (17+ years) with deep expertise across Oracle, MySQL/MariaDB, PostgreSQL, SQL Server, and a growing focus on Cloud Automation, DevOps, and Infrastructure Modernization.

docs.title: 🧠 What This Site Covers
docs.text:
This documentation hub is my centralized knowledge base for: - 🗄️ RDBMS – Oracle, MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQL Server - ☁️ Cloud – AWS, OCI, Azure - 🐧 OS Virtualization – Linux, Oracle KVM - ⚙️ DevOps – Ansible, Terraform, GitHub Actions - 🧩 Scripting – Bash, Shell, PowerShell, Python - 📊 Monitoring – OEM, Grafana, Prometheus, ELK - 💡 NoSQL – MongoDB, Cassandra, Redis

Each section includes structured guides, automation scripts, runbooks, and architecture diagrams.

docs.text:
This site is built using MkDocs Material and hosted via GitHub Pages. Every push to the main branch automatically deploys the latest version of my documentation.
